question: How should each syllable of the name to be accomplished be grasped?
premises: sādhyanāmākṣaraṃ is the syllable of the name to be accomplished
inference: The practitioner grasps each syllable of the name to be accomplished one by one.
uncertainties: whether avaṣṭabhya implies physical or mental grasping
plain_english: Grasp each syllable of the name to be accomplished, one by one, O beloved.
